summary: PO 2020 section 8 (Mitteilungsblatt 7/2020): two different specialization modules of 12 ECTS each (24 ECTS), 12 ECTS supplementary electives from the remaining offer, 12 ECTS advanced mathematics/computer science, 6 ECTS economics, 6 ECTS transport law, 6 ECTS additive key competencies, and the 24-ECTS thesis, after an approved study plan. Each specialization is its own 12-ECTS block. The checklist cannot force the two areas to differ, or stop one module from filling two slots. Additive key competencies and the thesis are not in this semester's module list.

categories.name: Advanced mathematics/computer science
categories.note: 12 ECTS of elective modules from advanced mathematics/computer science (section 8 (3)).

categories.name: Economics
categories.note: One module examination of 6 ECTS from Economics (section 8 (3)). A 3-ECTS course does not complete this area on its own.

categories.name: Transport law
categories.note: One module examination of 6 ECTS in transport law (section 8 (3)). eCampus lists it as two 3-ECTS parts, which together make the 6 ECTS.

categories.name: Supplementary electives
categories.note: 12 ECTS of electives from the rest of the program (section 8 (2)). Specialization courses count only when they were not already taken in either Schwerpunkt.

categories.name: Specialization A
categories.note: 12 ECTS in one of the six specializations; if that specialization offers more than 12 ECTS, its modules are freely chosen up to 12 (section 8 (1)). The area must differ from Specialization B, and a module cannot count toward both specialization slots.

categories.name: Specialization B
categories.note: 12 ECTS in one of the six specializations; if that specialization offers more than 12 ECTS, its modules are freely chosen up to 12 (section 8 (1)). The area must differ from Specialization A, and a module cannot count toward both specialization slots.
